messages:
anya: Quick flag: a 12-minute ingestion gap (2026-03-20 21:54-22:06 UTC) missed the hourly roll. Thinking about a microcatchup flow instead of firing a full backfill for that shard. Thoughts? :mag:

sam: How many events? if small we can delta-replay and avoid touching full aggregators. watch tenant slot quotas. :warning:

anya: ~30k events mostly for 2 tenants. conservative estimator unclear because some aggregation paths are per-record.

priya: We have a staging prefix-stitch prototype. Proposal: a `/v2/replay/delta` endpoint that guarantees idempotent upserts and accepts `catchup_reason` tag. Keeps semantics separate from v1.

mike: Console needs a microcatchup toggle and an upfront ETA+cost card. Current UX shows full-backfill numbers which are misleading. tiny toggle: "affected windows only" vs "replay shard".

judy: Ops: ensure scheduler treats microjobs as low-resource but still respects reserved lanes. If capacity pressure, route to fallback pool instead of failing. Emit telemetry for preemptions.

priya: API contract: require `idempotency_token` + `catchup_reason=late_ingest_miniwindow`. Also add `max_affected_tenants` param default 3.

ops-bot: deploybot: queued dry-run delta for 2026-03-20T21:54Z-22:06Z on prod-sim. job id=job-20260320-634.

ops-bot: deploybot: dry-run done. estimator: rows="~1.2k", token_reads="~95k", est_cost_usd="0.27", peak_mem_mb="540".

sam: Good. UX should auto-group adjacent tiny windows into a single micro-batch and show a concurrency slider (1-3). Also disable run if estimator predicts quota breach.

mike: I'll mock quick flows and link. console should also show "expected fallbacks" if reserved lanes are tight.

priya: Platform will draft `/v2/replay/delta` spec and include telemetry keys (catchup_reason, idempotency_token, microbatch_id).

judy: SRE will add alert if >5% microcatchups preempt or if average completion >2x ETA.

anya: Thanks. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up to review dry-run results + API mock + UX.
